payload.title: File:Eggshell associated with Beibeilong sinensis (HGM 41HIII1219).jpg
payload.artist_html: Hanyong Pu, Darla K. Zelenitsky, Junchang Lü, Philip J. Currie, Kenneth Carpenter, Li Xu, Eva B. Koppelhus, Songhai Jia, Le Xiao, Huali Chuang, Tianran Li, Martin Kundrát & Caizhi Shen.
payload.description_html: (a) Photograph showing the ornamentation on the outer surface of Macroelongatoolithus eggshell. Scale bar, 2 cm. (b) Photomicrograph showing histological section of Macroelongatoolithus eggshell in radial view shows two microstructural layers (lower mammillary layer and upper continuous layer) demarcated by an undulatory boundary (arrow). Scale bar is 1 mm.
